analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI slightly declined from 56.0 to 55.9, continuing in the neutral zone. MACD histogram worsened from 270.9796 to 229.2389, confirming a slowdown in upward momentum. Volume ratio at 0.75 indicates contraction. Current price of 38,965 is near the swing resistance of 39,030 and has slightly pulled back, making entry unfavorable. 52-week position at 56.8% is neutral. ADX at 12.4 signals a lack of trend formation.
